title: Landing: choose the structure
question: Same world (handoff tokens). Three structures for `/`: season snapshot first, then a glimpse of what the site offers. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Portada de jornada
options.thesis: The landing is the matchday front page: the season is the lead story, the rest of the site is the columns beside it.
options.viewport: Lead story (2/3): 2026/27 position, points, xG difference trend, reading headline, 'Ver la temporada'. Side column: latest match with mini shot map, last season's line. Bottom: three glimpse items and the provenance strip.
options.risk: A multi-column front page gets dense on a phone; it has to collapse into one clear reading order.

options.label: Escalera de profundidad
options.thesis: Season, match, chain, action: the page zooms one level per step, and depth itself is the pitch.
options.viewport: Full-width season snapshot band on top. Below it, four rungs step right and narrow: Temporada, Partido, Secuencia, Acción, each a real thumbnail with a link into the live page.
options.risk: The rungs below the fold carry the 'what else' story, so a visitor who never scrolls sees only the season.

options.label: Índice
options.thesis: A magazine contents page: the season is the cover and every section is a numbered chapter with a live preview and count.
options.viewport: Left: cover column with the 2026/27 snapshot and 2025/26 final line. Right: chapters 01 to 05 (Temporada, Partidos, Jugadores, Secuencias, Método), each with a thumbnail and a real count.
options.risk: A contents list can read as navigation rather than proof unless every chapter thumbnail is real data.
